originalText:
**Full framework**

**add before if you intend to make a question**

::1 [ connectors | ∅] +

[ [ WH ] + [object:optional | ∅] @ (WH ∈ {how, what, which})

+ [ modal verb +[not] | will +[not] +<Subject> | ∅]

+ [ ( to be | auxiliary verb ) | ∅ ] + [not + (even | ∅)] ] + …

**for normal sentences**

[ connectors | ∅] +

[ if | ∅] +

[frequency + ( do| does| did| have| has| had) @ frequency !∅ } | ∅] +

[<Subject> | ∅ ∈ imperative] +

[ [modal verbs | will] + [not + (even | ∅)]| ∅] +

[ (to be + [not + (even | ∅)] + [being] + [ (frequency| ∅) + ( going to | going to (be | have | have been) )] | auxiliary verb + [not + (even | ∅)] | ∅) ] +

[frequency_habit | ∅] +

[frequency_window | ∅] +

[frequency_emphasis | ∅]

@ total_frequency_slots ≤ 2

@ frequency_emphasis is exclusive

@ ∉ {going to} +

[been + (ING | past participle ) |∅] @ (auxiliary ∈ {have, has, had}) +

[ ( verb infinitive + (“s” | “es” |∅) | verb ING | irregular verb | verb past participle | verb + “ED” ) | ∅ ] +

**[report speech tag]**

**+ <complement | object >**

**[, tag question ? |∅ ] ↗ ::1**

**[report speech tag]**

**add this section before <complement | object> section**

( [that | had | ∅] + [<Subject>]

+ [ [modal verbs] + [not] | ∅] + [ (to be | auxiliary verb + [not + (even | ∅)] | ∅) ] +

[ ( verb infinitive + (“s” | “es”) | verb ING | irregular verb | verb past participle | verb + “ED” ) ] | ∅ )
